scope: Completed matched single-seed development comparison; aggregate metrics and rendered recovery only. Full provenance and raw payloads are retained in the archived experiment.

producer.note: Recorded training hashes refer to each fit training_commit; archive_commit pins the later archived analysis checkout and its Git history.

protocol.noise_policy: immutable stored noisy observations; no fresh-noise augmentation
protocol.support_policy: raw unbounded draws retained without clipping, rejection or resampling
protocol.checkpoint_policy: final epoch300 primary; distinct validation minimum secondary; no diagnostic selection
